text: Evening. My stepdaughter is 1 month old (born 4.5 weeks ago). Temperature 38.5 taken just now. Her crying is not her normal cry - it's weak and high, kind of thin, and it doesn't really stop, like a constant whine. Moja żona says the same, to nie jest jej normalny płacz. She also has a sore red nappy rash, quite raw looking. Proszę let me know what we should do.
